evidence: ASSIGN RECE41PARA style file assignment typical of GnuCOBOL/ORCA
no EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, consistent with GnuCOBOL usage

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (Rezept) processing system — monthly billing, self-pay/insurance claim detail file creation and point aggregation for outpatient/inpatient claims
purpose.summary: ORCR0420 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software suite. It creates monthly business detail files for insurance claims (Rousai/Jibaiseki — workers' compensation and automobile liability insurance), aggregating diagnosis-category point totals. It has an extensive revision history spanning 2002–2013 covering numerous Japanese medical fee revision cycles.

notable_features: 36 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
187 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access (multiple SELECT entries)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure file-based batch
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Long revision history with named maintainers (NACL team)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (garbled in latin-1 view). This is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used by Japanese clinics. The filename pattern ORCR0420 is consistent with the ORCA receipt subsystem naming convention.
